entities.name: St. Joseph's Church, Semarang
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Joseph's Church, also known as Gedangan Church, is a Catholic church in Semarang, Indonesia, the first such church in the city. Administratively, it is part of the St. Joseph's Parish in the Archdiocese of Semarang.
